title: Durable Authorized Injection stored-record digest recomputation

phases.objective: Recompute every stored state and rollback record SHA-256 from the parsed JSON core instead of trusting equality between the embedded digest and SQL digest column.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A previously valid persisted state row whose JSON content and both digest fields are modified together
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The reader recomputes SHA-256 from the stored JSON core and rejects the row with STORAGE_DURABLE_INJECTION_RECORD_DIGEST_MISMATCH before returning recovery evidence.
steps: Persist a canonical Receipt and Mount Readback through the existing durable registry.
Modify a provenance field inside the stored JSON record.
Set both the JSON record_digest and SQL record_digest column to the same attacker-chosen lowercase SHA-256-shaped value.
Read the state through a restarted canonical registry.
Recompute the digest after removing record_digest from the JSON core.
Reject when the recomputed digest differs, even though the two stored digest fields match.
Restore the original row and complete restart reconstruction and rollback regressions unchanged.
assertions: Both SQL-column and embedded record digests must be valid lowercase SHA-256 values.
The embedded digest must equal the SQL-column digest.
The SHA-256 recomputed from the stored JSON core must equal both stored digests.
Rewritten content with matching fake digest fields is rejected.
Valid registration, replay, restart reconstruction, rollback CAS, and no-runtime-material boundaries remain unchanged.
No schema, migration, Route, Server, provider, live DB, main, or Production mutation occurs.

phases.objective: This is a repository read-integrity correction and introduces no live operation.
Fail closed for malformed, mismatched, or content-invalid state and rollback records while preserving all current restart and rollback behavior.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The original untampered durable row restored after the integrity probe
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Restart reconstruction returns the exact original readback and rollback remains CAS-bound, while runtime material and live authority remain absent.
steps: Restore the original canonical state row.
Read and reconstruct the Authorized Injection coordinator.
Verify exact Mount Readback digest continuity.
Record rollback through the existing row-version CAS path.
Verify rolled-back reactivation and rollback replay remain rejected.
assertions: The hardening does not change valid record digests or lifecycle output.
Provider dispatch, migration Apply, Production readiness, and automatic retry remain false.

phases.objective: No live environment or provider canary is authorized.
No deployment, migration, main merge, or Production authority is introduced.
